comments.content:
[medium] The exception type here is inconsistent: the other template functions signal failures with `PebbleException`, while this one throws `IllegalArgumentException`, which can sidestep Pebble's line/template reporting and make debugging harder. Better to throw `PebbleException` including lineNumber/self (passing them into this method) so error handling stays uniform.

```suggestion
                throw new PebbleException(null, "Unable to read the file '" + path + "' as it doesn't belong to the current execution", lineNumber, self.getName());
```
[low] Consider checking the interaction between `isFileFromCurrentExecution` and a retry or repeated-call path.
[low] Consider testing `fileExistsFunction` when two callers reach this code with different configuration values.
